paragraphs: A roller stand is a second pair of hands. Anything longer than the bench needs support at the far end, and the whole design is about being set to the exact height of a saw table and then folded away when the cut is done.
The model is supplied with the pipe, in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and is built to CheckMate specification.
At $39 it suits workshop and site visualisation, tool and equipment marketing, e-commerce imagery, training material, film props and game environments. On sale since 2025.

Airless spraying atomises paint by forcing it through a tiny hole at very high pressure rather than mixing it with air. The result covers far faster and the tip is dangerous enough that the trigger has a guard for reasons that are not about the paint.
The model is very light at 7,672 polygons and 7,883 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits tool and equipment marketing, decorating and construction visualisation, e-commerce imagery, training material, film props and game environments. On sale since 2021.

The mask that drops from the ceiling is not connected to a tank. It is fed by a chemical generator that starts when the mask is pulled, burns for a fixed number of minutes and cannot be switched off, which is why the briefing insists on pulling it down firmly.
The model is light at 18,638 polygons and 18,736 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 4 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits aviation safety and training visualisation, cabin scenes, equipment marketing, film and television props, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2016.

A six pack is a unit of packaging design as much as of drink. The shrink wrap or the ring has to hold the cans in a shape that stacks, carries and photographs, and the label artwork is drawn knowing it will be seen in that block rather than alone.
The model holds 84,816 polygons and 51,270 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, in black. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits packaging and label mockups, beverage and product visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

The streaming stick turned any television into a smart one and made the manufacturer's own software irrelevant, which is why the device is sold at a loss. The remote is the actual product: it is what the user touches and where the brand lives.
The set is very light at 10,866 polygons and 11,673 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits product and technology visualisation, e-commerce and packaging imagery, advertising, living room and interior scenes, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

Amber is fossilised tree resin, not a mineral, which is why it is warm to the touch and light enough to float in salt water. Everything trapped inside one is a snapshot of a forest that stopped existing tens of millions of years ago.
The model is extremely light at 756 polygons and 763 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so it costs nothing anywhere. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits jewellery and product visualisation, natural history and museum work, e-commerce imagery, education material, game props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

An ear tag is a database entry made physical. The colour codes the year or the group, the number identifies the animal, and the applicator exists because the tag has to go through cartilage in one movement to heal cleanly.
The model is light at 29,450 polygons and 14,783 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied with multicoloured tags. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits agricultural and veterinary visualisation, livestock equipment marketing, training material, e-commerce imagery, documentary work and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

The Cube was a commercial failure and is in design collections anyway. It was silent because it had no fan, suspended in acrylic so it appeared to float, and priced for people who valued that more than they valued expandability. Almost nobody did.
The model holds 55,816 polygons and 54,388 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $39 it suits product and design visualisation, museum and exhibition work, period interior and film scenes, e-commerce imagery, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

A majlis seats people around the edge of the room facing inward, which is a completely different social geometry from furniture arranged toward a screen. Everyone can see everyone, nobody has the head of the table, and the conversation is the point.
The model holds 299,752 polygons and 314,480 vertices, built in quads only with mixed UV layout, in red. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $39 it suits interior and architectural visualisation, hospitality and residential presentation, cultural scenes, furniture marketing, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2026.

Plastic trolleys replaced wire ones because they do not rust, do not rattle and can be moulded in a colour that matches a brand. They are also lighter, which matters enormously to the person who has to push forty of them back across a car park.
The model holds 84,771 polygons and 86,256 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 5 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries StemCell certification.
At $39 it suits retail and supermarket visualisation, equipment marketing, store interiors, advertising, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2020.

A reed diffuser is a candle that cannot be forgotten about. The sticks wick oil up by capillary action at a rate nobody controls, which is exactly why it sells: the product works while the owner does nothing at all.
The model is extremely light at 4,532 polygons and 2,280 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits product and packaging visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, interior and hospitality scenes, advertising, film set dressing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.

A toy astronaut is the first spacecraft most people ever hold. The proportions are wrong on purpose, the helmet is oversized so a face fits inside it, and the whole figure is designed to survive being dropped rather than to resemble anything real.
The model is light at 11,209 polygons and 11,055 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in white and a happy pose. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 it suits toy and product visualisation, children's media and animation, e-commerce imagery, advertising, game characters and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

Grill marks are the entire visual language of barbecue. They are a Maillard reaction in stripes, they tell the viewer the meat touched something hot, and food photography arranges every chop so that they run diagonally across the frame.

The model is extremely light at 3,056 polygons and 3,059 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 8 maps, 4 at 4096x4096 and 4 at 2048x2048. It carries StemCell certification.
At $39 it suits food and menu visualisation, restaurant and packaging imagery, advertising, kitchen scenes, game props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2019.

Cue sports gear is precision equipment that looks like furniture accessories. The balls are matched to a fraction of a gram, the cue tip is chalked because friction is the only thing that lets a player put spin on anything, and the rack exists to make the break fair.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the equipment as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $39 the set suits sports and leisure visualisation, bar and games room interiors, e-commerce imagery, advertising, film set dressing and game environments. On sale since 2018.
